title: 第1章  军营钉子户，终于退伍了！
slug: 四次入伍我被军区拉进黑名单
content_zh:
“送战友，踏征程，默默无语两眼泪……”
装甲旅，机械化步兵一连。
军人俱乐部的墙上扯满了“致敬老兵，一路顺风”的红色横幅，那首‘军中禁歌’的旋律不知送走了多少人，来来回回的放。
即退的老兵们身着笔挺常服，胸前的大红花格外鲜艳，每个人的眼眶都涨的通红。
不知道是谁先绷不住了，喉咙里滚出一声压抑的哽咽，瞬间打破了平静。
紧跟着，一个跟一个的老兵全都忍不住了，有的低头抹着眼泪，有的肩膀微微颤抖，还有的紧紧攥着战友的手，千言万语，最终都化作了无声的泪水，泣不成声。
唯独林毅静静地坐在角落，坐姿有些散漫，都要走的人了，脸色平静没有丝毫波澜，反而眼神里还带了一丝终于解脱的庆幸。
坐在他旁边的老兵抹了把眼泪，用胳膊肘怼了怼他：“老林，你就对我们这些老战友一点感情都没有？你就对部队一点感情都没有？”
林毅刚想张嘴，班长刘畅冷哼一声：“没感情？这小子的感情，比咱们谁都深！”
这话一出，周围几个正抹眼泪的老兵一个没憋住，“噗嗤”一声破涕而笑。
在场的人谁不知道林毅的事迹？
放眼全国军区，这都是独一份的奇谈。
林毅翻了个白眼：“你们这话说的好像我故意折腾似的，你们以为我愿意啊！”
刘畅往长椅上一靠：“是，你确实不是故意的，但架不住你事迹太牛了啊！三次入伍，三次退伍，三进三出，这事迹你能吹一辈子！”
一众老兵们再也哭不出来了，纷纷笑开了花。
林毅仰头45°看向天花板，一脸生无可恋的样子：“我现在不想说话，我只想静静跟婷婷，也别问我静静跟婷婷是谁。”
刘畅笑了几声后，眼神变得认真起来：“不过说真的，这次你是真要走了？不会又被老爷子或者咱旅长抓回来吧？”
林毅眼神中满是憧憬：“必须的，这回真走了。”
刘畅还是不放心，又追问了一句：“你确定？是那种不反悔、不半路又折回来的那种？”
林毅嫌弃的笑骂道：“妈的，老子什么时候反悔过？前几次那都是不可抗力！老子这次，绝对要走！天王老子也拦不住我！我说的！”

这话一出口，周围参加送别晚会的老兵和新兵们的笑声更大了。
林毅，这个肩膀上挂了六年新兵军衔的‘钉子户’，早已成为了军营里口口相传的明星人物，不管新兵老兵，谁也逃不过聆听他的威名。
谁不知道这小子比谁都想离开军营，自由才是他的追求。
但偏偏林毅家里那两片天，就是不遂了他的愿，两次退伍都没成过。
四年前，他第一次退伍，大红花一戴，马上要滚蛋了，结果老爷子一通电话下来，送兵大巴车的屁股还没坐热乎，当时的连长直接冲上车，给他生生硬拽了下来。
不愿意留队抢占战友士官名额是吧？
直接二次入伍！
列兵军衔直接往身上就是一套！
林毅欲哭无泪。
再是两年前。
老爷子退了，他把退伍手续都办好了，结果回到地方，街道办却告诉他户籍没转回来。
一打听才知道，草了，产房里传喜讯，他爹升了，成了装甲旅的一把手，一脚又给他踹回了部队。
这一待，转眼六年过去了。
常言铁打的营盘流水的兵，然而林毅这个“新兵钉子户”的大名，也是无人不知无人不晓！常常引为笑谈。
俱乐部里的笑声过后，老兵们脸上的笑容渐渐褪去，眼神里都多了些许的感慨。
林毅瞅着这帮战友，不禁愣了一下：“妈的，搞什么？老子这回真走了，你们咋又不笑了？不该替我高兴吗？”
他转头看向刘畅，挑了挑眉：“老刘，你不是整天盼着我赶紧滚蛋吗？你现在不应该大笑吗？你不会……舍不得了吧？”
刘畅猛地回过神来，骂骂咧咧：“我舍不得？放你娘的屁！你他娘的在部队待的这六年，给我惹了多少祸？”
“偷炊事班的鸡，霍霍养殖场的猪，还把猪吓得撞破围栏跑了，全连出动找猪，还有那些乱七八糟的事儿，我还用说？其他班的班长三天两头来我这打小报告，老子恨不得一脚给你踹出部队去！”
林毅笑了笑：“这不就得了？那我走了你应该高兴啊。”

“对！老子可高兴了！老子都快高兴死了！”刘畅扯着嗓子喊了两句，爽朗大笑起来。
可笑着笑着，他猛地转身，一把将林毅紧紧抱住，肩膀剧烈地颤抖着，嘴里含糊地骂着。
“娘的，你这次真的能退？”
“艹，老子本来还指望你下次比武，给我拿下全团第一，好让我在其他班长面前扬眉吐气呢！你走了，谁给我争这口气啊！”
林毅轻轻拍着刘畅的后背：“行了行了，婆婆妈妈的，能不能像个爷们一样？别哭了，多大点事，老子又不是死了。”
“不过以后是没机会给你拿比武第一了，也没机会再给你惹麻烦了，估计，也没多少机会见面了。”
刘畅哭得更凶了，紧紧抱着林毅，不肯松手。
周围的老兵们，也都红了眼眶，纷纷上前，围着林毅，一个个伸手抱住他。
“老林，回去好好过日子，别再折腾了。”
“不管以后在哪，咱们都是战友，有事随时说话！”
林毅挨个回应着，拍了拍每个战友的肩膀。
六年军旅，吵过闹过，闯过祸挨过骂，可此刻，所有的过往都化作了战友情。
虽然他一直都没想在部队长待，时时刻刻都想着离开，但这份情谊却不知不觉间也深埋心底，挥之不去。
“咳咳。”
就在这时，一声轻微的咳嗽声响起。
众人回过神来看向声音传来的地方。
顿时，所有人都下意识地站直身体，齐声喊道：“副连长！”
赵明辉穿着一身笔挺的军官常服，肩上的一毛二在灯光下格外醒目。
他目光越过众人，落在林毅身上：“林毅，你过来。”
林默迈步跟上赵明辉的脚步。

来到无人的角落。
赵明辉转身看着林毅，挑眉问：“这次你的退伍申请表顺利通过了，这次怎么说通你家那两位大佛的？”
“谁知道呢，可能是转性了？”林毅懒得琢磨那些，“反正，老子终于能飞出这座大熔炉了！”
为此，他还专门列了个表。
接下来的一个月，不，一年，他要好好的爽一爽！把这六年亏欠的，全都找补回来！
赵明辉愣了愣，把手里那根烟塞进林毅嘴里，顺手给自己和林毅都点上。
“行啊，不管怎么说，你小子总算是如愿了。”
“是啊，如愿了。”林毅深吸一口烟，吐出来，烟雾里赵明辉肩上的一毛二若隐若现。
然后他抬手，啪啪拍在赵明辉肩膀上，架势活像个老首长嘱托新兵蛋子。
“明天我就走了，老赵你在部队好好干，别给老子丢人。”
“滚蛋！”赵明辉翻了个白眼，“我用你嘱托？老子军校优秀毕业生，二十四岁就扛上副连长，你去全军区打听打听有几个？你小子可真不要碧莲了啊！”
嘴上骂得凶，可他看着林毅的眼神，却实实在在浮着一层藏不住的复杂。
一起进部队的同年兵越来越少了，没想到就连林毅这个钉子户今年也要退了，让人不禁唏嘘，如鲠在喉，情绪难言。
林毅嘿嘿一乐，转身迈开步子往回走。
赵明辉盯着那道吊儿郎当的背影，轻骂了句：“这孙子……”
这个林毅啊，三次入伍三次退伍，进进出出跟逛自家后院似的。
明明一身本事谁也比不了，偏偏这条军旅路却走得磕磕绊绊，临了了让人连句“前程似锦”都不知从哪儿说起。
不过他这次，真能这么顺利的就退喽？
content_en:
"Sending off my comrades on the journey, silently and with tears..."
Armored Brigade, 1st Company of Mechanized Infantry.
The walls of the military club were covered with red banners that read "Salute to veterans, have a safe journey." The melody of the "Forbidden Song in the Military" sent away countless people and was played back and forth.
The veterans who were about to retire were dressed in straight uniforms, and the big red flowers on their chests were particularly bright, and everyone's eyes were red.
I don't know who lost control first, and a suppressed sob rolled out of his throat, instantly breaking the calm.
Immediately afterwards, one after another, the veterans couldn't help it anymore. Some lowered their heads and wiped away tears, some shoulders shook slightly, and some tightly held the hands of their comrades. Thousands of words they said eventually turned into silent tears, and they broke down in sobs.
Only Lin Yi was sitting quietly in the corner, his posture was a little sloppy, he was about to leave, his face was calm without any waves, but there was a trace of happiness in his eyes that he was finally free.
The veteran sitting next to him wiped away his tears and hit him with his elbow: "Old Lin, you have no feelings for us old comrades? Do you have no feelings for the army?"
Just when Lin Yi was about to open his mouth, squad leader Liu Chang snorted: "No feelings? This kid's feelings are deeper than any of us!"
As soon as these words came out, none of the veterans who were wiping their tears around them could hold back their tears and burst out laughing.
Who here doesn’t know Lin Yi’s deeds?
Looking at military districts across the country, this is a unique story.
Ji Yi rolled his eyes: "You are saying this as if I am deliberately trying to do this. Do you think I am willing?"
Liu Chang leaned back on the bench: "Yes, you really didn't mean it, but your achievements are so awesome! Three times you enlisted in the army, three times you were discharged from the army, three times you were in and three times you were out, you can brag about this for the rest of your life!"
All the veterans could no longer cry and burst out laughing.
Ji Yi raised his head at a 45° angle and looked at the ceiling, with a look of despair on his face: "I don't want to talk now, I just want to be with Tingting quietly, and don't ask me who Tingting and Tingting are."
After Liu Chang laughed a few times, his eyes became serious: "But seriously, are you really going to leave this time? You won't be caught back by the old man or our brigade commander, right?"
Ji Yi's eyes were full of longing: "It's necessary, I'm really leaving this time."
Liu Chang was still worried and asked again: "Are you sure? The kind that doesn't regret or come back halfway?"
Ji Yi laughed and cursed in disgust: "Damn it, when have I ever regretted it? The past few times were all force majeure! This time, I will definitely leave! Even the King of Heaven can't stop me! I said so!"
As soon as these words came out, the laughter of the veterans and recruits attending the farewell party became even louder.
Lin Yi, who has held the rank of a recruit for six years on his shoulders, has already become a famous figure in the military camp. Regardless of whether he is a recruit or a veteran, no one can escape hearing about his reputation.
Who doesn't know that this kid wants to leave the military camp more than anyone else, and freedom is his pursuit.
But the two pieces of land in Lin Yi's home failed to fulfill his wish, and he failed to get discharged from the army twice.
Four years ago, he was discharged from the army for the first time. As soon as he put on the big red flower, he was about to get out. As soon as the old man got off the phone, before he got on the bus, the company commander at the time rushed into the bus and pulled him off.
You don't want to stay in the team to seize the quota of comrades as non-commissioned officers, right?
Enlist directly for the second time!
The rank of private is applied directly to the body!
Lin Yi wanted to cry but had no tears.
Two years ago again.
The old man retired and completed all the discharge procedures. When he returned to his hometown, the street office told him that his household registration had not been transferred back.
When I inquired about it, I found out that there was good news in the delivery room. His father had been promoted to the top of the armored brigade, and he was kicked back to the army.
After this, six years passed in the blink of an eye.
As the saying goes, the soldiers who make the camp strong are the soldiers who are running smoothly. However, Lin Yi, who is known as the "nail house of new recruits", is also unparalleled.No one knows, no one knows! Often made a joke.
After the laughter in the club, the smiles on the faces of the veterans gradually faded, and there was a little more emotion in their eyes.
Lin Yi looked at these comrades and couldn't help but be stunned for a moment: "Damn, what are you doing? I'm really gone this time, why don't you laugh again? Shouldn't you be happy for me?"
He turned to look at Liu Chang and raised his eyebrows: "Old Liu, haven't you been waiting for me to get out of here all day? Shouldn't you be laughing now? You won't...can't bear it, right?"
Liu Chang suddenly came back to his senses and cursed: "I can't bear it? Fuck you! How much trouble have you caused me in the six years you've been in the army?"
"Stealing chickens from the cooking class, pigs from the Huohuo Farm, scaring the pigs so much that they broke through the fence and ran away. The whole company went out to look for the pigs, and all those other messy things. Need I mention it? The squad leaders from other squads come to my place every three days to report. I wish I could kick you out of the army!"
Ji Yi smiled: "Isn't that enough? Then you should be happy that I'm leaving."
"Yes! I'm so happy! I'm almost overjoyed!" Liu Chang shouted a few words at the top of his voice, laughing heartily.
Ke smiled, turned around suddenly, hugged Ji Yi tightly, his shoulders shook violently, and he cursed vaguely.
"Mom, can you really quit this time?"
"Fuck, I originally expected you to win the first place in the whole group for me in the next martial arts competition, so that I can feel proud in front of other squad leaders! If you leave, who will give me this reputation!"
Ji Yi patted Liu Chang's back gently: "Okay, okay, mother-in-law, can you be like a man? Stop crying, it's no big deal, I'm not dead."
"But I won't have the chance to win the first place in the martial arts competition for you in the future, and I won't have the chance to cause you any more trouble. I guess there won't be many opportunities to meet."
Liu Chang cried even harder, hugging Ji Yi tightly and refusing to let go.
The surrounding veterans also had red eyes, and they all stepped forward, surrounded Ji Yi, and stretched out their arms to hug him.
"Old Lin, go back and live a good life, don't bother anymore."
"No matter where we are in the future, we are all comrades-in-arms, and we can talk anytime if anything happens!"
Ji Yi responded one by one and patted each comrade on the shoulder.
During the six years of military service, there were quarrels, troubles, and scoldings, but at this moment, all the past had turned into comradeship.
Although he never wanted to be the captain of the army and thought about leaving all the time, this friendship was unknowingly buried deep in his heart and lingered.
"Ahem."
At this moment, a slight cough sounded.
Everyone came back to their senses and looked towards the place where the sound came from.
Suddenly, everyone subconsciously stood up straight and shouted in unison: "Deputy Company Commander!"
Zhao Minghui was wearing a straight uniform as an officer, and the hair on his shoulders was particularly eye-catching under the light.
He looked across the crowd and landed on Ji Yi: "Jin Yi, come here."
Lin Mo stepped forward to follow Zhao Minghui's footsteps.
Come to a deserted corner.
Zhao Minghui turned to look at Lin Yi, raised his eyebrows and asked: "This time your discharge application form was successfully passed. How did you get through the two big Buddhas in your family this time?"
"Who knows, maybe he has changed his gender?" Ji Yi was too lazy to think about that, "Anyway, I can finally fly out of this melting pot!"
To this end, he also made a special list.
In the next month, no, one year, he will have a good time! Make up for all the debt you have owed in the past six years!
Zhao Minghui was stunned, put the cigarette in his hand into Ji Yi's mouth, and lit it for himself and Lin Yi.
"Okay, no matter what, you finally got your wish."
"Yes, I got my wish." Lin Yi took a deep breath of cigarette and exhaled it. The hair on Zhao Minghui's shoulder was looming in the smoke.
Then he raised his hand and patted Zhao Minghui on the shoulder, as if he was an old leader giving advice to a new recruit.
"I'll leave tomorrow. Lao Zhao, do your job well in the army. Don'tEmbarrass me. "
“Get out! "Zhao Minghui rolled his eyes, "Should I use your instructions? I am an outstanding graduate of the Military Academy who was promoted to deputy company commander at the age of twenty-four. How many of them are there in the entire military region? You kid really doesn’t want Bilian anymore! "
He was scolding fiercely, but the way he looked at Ji Yi was filled with a layer of complexity that he couldn't hide.
There are fewer and fewer soldiers of the same age who joined the army together. Unexpectedly, even Lin Yi, a tough guy, will retire this year, which makes people feel sad, like a lump in their throats, and their emotions are hard to describe.
Lin Yi laughed, turned around and walked back.
Zhao Minghui stared at the careless figure and cursed lightly: "This grandson..."
This Lin Yi has enlisted in the army three times and been discharged from the army three times. He comes in and out as if he were visiting his own backyard.
It is clear that no one can match his abilities, but this military journey has been bumpy and bumpy. At the end of the day, people don't even know where to start saying "the future is bright".
But this time, could he really retreat so smoothly?
